verdict.rationale: Secureframe tracks personnel tasks, with reminders for policy acceptance and security awareness training, and custom Personnel fields. Its access reviews let reviewers revoke access and create follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing tools, which partly evidences that leavers lose access. Missing for 10: explicit HR-system (HRIS) sync, dedicated onboarding/offboarding checklists triggered by hire/termination events, offboarding access-revocation verification tied to departures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
